review_scope: Independent read-only review of adapter/models/training/config freeze plus acquisition/raw boundary; temporary synthetic CPU probes

review_observations.sampling: All 30000 source minibatches at seed42 for all three folds verified: batch32, source16+16, each domain/class count1 or2, indices only from source train membership.
review_observations.nine_class_metrics: Explicit labels0..8 and 9x9 confusion; macroF1 reduces per class within each run.
review_observations.target_model_access: train_source accepts only source partitions and fixed source schedule; search seed excluded by evaluate_target; strict checkpoint reload precedes target dataset retrieval.
review_observations.hybrid: fullB forward before sample-major auxiliary3B; same identity positive across views, distinct class positive full/full, CE full only.
review_observations.coral: Joint-source fused feature mean difference plus unbiased covariance difference, each element mean; separate source-only gamma selection.
review_observations.me: Generic masked_forward_exposure=True executes auxiliary forwards at zero SupCon weight; formal MultiEnv ME adapter/config not supplied by WiMANS package.
review_observations.checkpoint_resume: Fixed30000 budget, source accuracy last tied best, strict reload; epoch-zero durable checkpoint added after peer finding.
review_observations.storage_order: Fallback registration checks exact slice0, groups0..2, subcarriers0..29, C-order, phase/no reperm and physical axis uncertainty; all1782 numerical QA and manifest bindings required.

separate_raw_access_disclosure.transport: Kaggle individual MAT ZIP download in acquisition helper
separate_raw_access_disclosure.cause: While peer probe was testing the old immediate rejection of synthetic unreceipted bytes, concurrent root repair made that function redownload the pinned file into memory before comparison.
separate_raw_access_disclosure.outcome: helper rejected digest/length mismatch and preserved synthetic bytes; real response payload was not persisted
separate_raw_access_disclosure.followup: All subsequent acquisition peer tests patch requests.get with local fake ZIP bytes; no repeated real download.

limitations: This receipt review and seed42 full schedule check do not replace complete actual1782 input QA, source batch32 short training, or formal job freeze.
No real WiMANS signal row was passed to an encoder by this reviewer; one raw file transport access is disclosed separately.
The owner tests for model/RNG/BN and actual training-loop interruption are separate evidence; this peer check did not duplicate GPU or real-signal runs.
Code may evolve after this snapshot; the recorded SHA256 identifies the reviewed version.
